summary: RAF Lakenheath is a Royal Air Force station in Suffolk, England, primarily operated by the United States Air Force's 48th Fighter Wing. It serves as a key NATO installation hosting F-15E Strike Eagle and F-15C/D Eagle fighter squadrons under an enduring Anglo-American partnership. Located near the market town of Brandon, the base is one of two major USAF installations in the United Kingdom.
